paragraphs.text: Hatificer is a acorn class of those that create and fight with magical or technological hats.

Hatificer was introduced as as a Silver-bordered class in Unstable for a goblin and later reappeared in Unfinity for a human at Myra the Magnificent's Intergalactic Astrotorium of Fun . They are similar to artificers but specialized towards hats. Some Hatificers will have explosives like dynamite as part of their hat while others have blades.
